faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We Clarify Your Doubts
faq.description: We have gathered the most common questions about our treatments. Didn't find the answer you are looking for? Contact us.
faq.cta_desc: Our team will answer your questions at the assessment appointment.

ortho_time.question: How long does orthodontic treatment take?
ortho_time.answer: The duration depends on the complexity of the case. At the assessment appointment we give an estimate for your situation.

implants_pain.question: Do dental implants hurt?
implants_pain.answer: The procedure is performed under local anaesthesia. After surgery there may be some discomfort, which is managed with the medication prescribed by the dentist. Recovery time varies from person to person.

veneers_cost.question: How much do porcelain veneers cost?
veneers_cost.answer: The price of veneers depends on the number of teeth and the complexity of the case, and is set out in a written quote after the appointment. The first assessment appointment is free of charge; imaging tests, if needed, are quoted separately.

whitening_safety.question: Is teeth whitening safe?
whitening_safety.answer: When indicated and carried out by qualified professionals with approved products. Temporary sensitivity may occur. We always assess dental health beforehand.

bone_graft.question: Do I need a bone graft to place implants?
bone_graft.answer: It depends on the amount and quality of available bone, which we assess at the appointment with imaging tests. If a graft is needed, we explain the procedure, the risks and the costs.

durability.question: What is the durability of aesthetic treatments?
durability.answer: Durability depends on the treatment, each person's habits and maintenance. At the appointment we explain what to expect in your case and the schedule of check-ups.

insurance.question: Do you accept health insurance?
insurance.answer: Yes, we work with the main Portuguese health insurances. We always check coverage before treatment and help with reimbursement procedures. Contact us to confirm your specific insurance.

simultaneous.question: Is it possible to do multiple treatments simultaneously?
simultaneous.answer: In some cases treatments can be combined, when clinically appropriate. The treatment plan is defined after the assessment appointment.

hero.description: We care for patients who live outside Portugal: an in-person assessment in Porto, a written treatment plan stating the expected number of trips, and the same prices for all patients.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Patients living outside Portugal
faq.description: How we organise the assessment and treatment of people living outside Portugal.
faq.cta_desc: At the first appointment we assess your case and give you a written plan with the expected number of trips.

included.question: How does the follow-up work?
included.answer: It starts with an in-person assessment appointment in Porto and, if needed, tests. We then give you a written treatment plan with the stages, the expected number of trips and the quote.

language.question: Do I need to speak Portuguese?
language.answer: No. The team communicates in several languages, including English, French and Spanish.

treatments.question: How many trips will I need?
treatments.answer: The number of trips depends on the treatment plan and is only defined after the in-person assessment. It is stated in the written plan we give you.

accommodation.question: Does the clinic arrange travel or accommodation?
accommodation.answer: No. Travel and accommodation are arranged by the patient. We schedule appointments to make the most of each trip to Porto.

prices.question: Are prices different for people living outside Portugal?
prices.answer: No. Prices are the same for all patients, whether or not they live in Portugal. The first assessment appointment is free of charge; imaging tests, if needed, are quoted separately.

followup.question: What about follow-up after I return home?
followup.answer: We provide a clinical report you can share with your dentist in the country where you live. Check-ups take place in person, on dates agreed with you.

companion.question: Can I bring a companion?
companion.answer: Yes, you may bring a companion to your appointments.

faq.title: Questions about Transplant
faq.subtitle: FUE Hair Transplant
faq.description: Answers to frequently asked questions about FUE hair transplantation.
faq.cta_desc: At the appointment we assess your case and explain whether a transplant is indicated, the risks and the costs.

fue_technique.question: What is the FUE technique and how does it work?
fue_technique.answer: FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) is a hair transplant technique in which individual follicular units are extracted from the donor area and then implanted in the recipient area. Whether it is indicated depends on the clinical assessment.

pain.question: Is FUE hair transplant painful?
pain.answer: The procedure is performed under local anaesthesia. There may be some discomfort in the first days, managed with the medication prescribed by the doctor.

results_time.question: When will I see the final results?
results_time.answer: Transplanted hair grows progressively over several months. At the appointment we explain the expected course in your case; results vary from person to person.

sessions.question: How many sessions are necessary?
sessions.answer: In most cases, a single session is sufficient. Depending on the degree of baldness and aesthetic goals, a second session may be necessary after 12-18 months for greater density. During the consultation, we define a personalized plan for your specific case.

definitive.question: Does the transplanted hair last?
definitive.answer: Follicles are taken from a donor area that is usually less affected by hair loss. The outcome depends on each person and on the progression of hair loss in non-transplanted hair, which we monitor at check-ups.

recovery.question: What is the recovery time?
recovery.answer: Recovery time varies from person to person. At the appointment we explain post-operative care and the schedule of check-ups.

donor_area.question: Can I have a transplant if I have little donor hair?
donor_area.answer: We assess each case individually. If the donor area is limited, we explain what is possible in your case and, if indicated, other treatments.

natural_look.question: Does the result look natural?
natural_look.answer: Planning follows the direction of hair growth and an age-appropriate hairline. Results vary from person to person.

hero.description: Facial aesthetic treatments with Dr Arethuza Luna's team (OMD no. 11845). Whether a treatment is indicated depends on an assessment appointment, and results vary from person to person.

faq.title: Questions about Aesthetics
faq.subtitle: Facial Aesthetics
faq.description: We clarify all doubts about our facial aesthetics treatments. Safe and personalized procedures to enhance your natural beauty.
faq.cta_desc: At the appointment we assess your case and explain the suitable options, the risks and the costs.

types.question: What types of facial aesthetics treatments do you offer?
types.answer: We carry out treatments with botulinum toxin, hyaluronic acid fillers, chemical peels, facial mesotherapy, PDO threads and laser therapy. Whether each procedure is indicated is decided at the assessment appointment.

pain.question: Are facial aesthetics treatments painful?
pain.answer: There may be some discomfort during and after procedures. When needed, we use topical anaesthesia. At the appointment we explain what to expect from each treatment.

results_time.question: When will I see the results of the treatments?
results_time.answer: The time until effects are noticeable varies with the treatment and the person. At the appointment we explain what to expect from each procedure.

duration.question: How long do the results last?
duration.answer: How long effects last varies with the treatment, the area and the person. At the appointment we explain the maintenance plan suitable for you.

recovery.question: Is there any recovery time?
recovery.answer: It depends on the treatment. There may be temporary swelling or redness. We always provide written aftercare instructions.

suitability.question: How do I know which treatment is right for me?
suitability.answer: At the assessment appointment we look at your skin, concerns and goals, and explain the suitable options, risks and costs. The first assessment appointment is free of charge; imaging tests, if needed, are quoted separately.

safety.question: Are the treatments safe?
safety.answer: We use certified products and follow safety and hygiene protocols. Like any clinical procedure, these treatments carry risks, which we explain at the assessment appointment.

combination.question: Can I combine different treatments?
combination.answer: In some cases treatments can be combined, for example botulinum toxin with fillers, respecting safety intervals. The plan is defined at the assessment appointment.
